_meta.description: Party-to-alliance mapping for the 5 in-cycle states (May 2026 assembly elections)
_meta.source: ECI accepted alliance declarations filed pre-poll; cross-checked with ADR/MyNeta pre-poll affidavit data

_l1_decisions.aiadmk_status: AIADMK classified as Others for TN 2026 after formal split from BJP-NDA in June 2023. AIADMK contested 2024 LS independently and declared state-level elections would be fought alone. Not in NDA or INDIA blocs for S22 cycle.
_l1_decisions.pmk_status: PMK (Pattali Makkal Katchi) returned to NDA fold for TN 2026 per alliance declaration. Classified NDA for S22.
_l1_decisions.aiudf_status: AIUDF (All India United Democratic Front) in Assam declared opposition alliance with INC for 2026 under INDIA umbrella. Classified INDIA for S03.
_l1_decisions.iuml_status: IUML (Indian Union Muslim League) is part of UDF/INDIA alliance in Kerala. Classified INDIA for S11.
_l1_decisions.ldf_members_status: Kerala LDF parties (CPI(M), CPI, RSP, NCP-K) are formally outside the national INDIA alliance but contest in opposition to NDA. ECI filings show they contested independently as LDF. Classified as 'LDF' sub-alliance under Others to preserve meaningful state-level alliance data. Frontend should render LDF as a fourth color in Kerala.
_l1_decisions.udf_vs_india: Kerala UDF (INC, IUML, KC(M)) is formally part of INDIA alliance at national level. UDF parties classified INDIA for S11.
_l1_decisions.tmc_status: TMC (Trinamool Congress) in West Bengal is formally in INDIA alliance. Classified INDIA for S25.
_l1_decisions.adfp_status: ADFP (Assam Democratic Front) and smaller regional parties in Assam classified Others.
_l1_decisions.ainrc_status: AINRC (All India N.R. Congress) in Puducherry aligned with BJP/NDA for 2026. Classified NDA for S26.

CPIM._note: Kerala LDF component; classified LDF (sub-alliance under Others) for S11. In other states may be in INDIA alliance.

Monitor ECI declarations — if a formal bloc announcement is made before counting, update this entry.

PMK._note: PMK returned to NDA fold per alliance declaration for TN 2026

state_notes.S03: Assam 2026: BJP-AGP-UPPL-BPF form NDA coalition. INC-AIUDF form primary INDIA opposition. Some tribal parties (UPPL, NPP) may contest independently in reserved seats.
state_notes.S11: Kerala 2026: LDF (CPI(M)-led) and UDF (INC-IUML-led) are the two main fronts. NDA contests but has historically not won seats in Kerala assembly. LDF classified separately as it is not formally part of INDIA bloc despite both opposing NDA.
state_notes.S22: Tamil Nadu 2026: DMK-led INDIA alliance faces AIADMK independently and BJP-PMK NDA. AIADMK's split from NDA in 2023 significantly changed TN political calculus. AIMIM contests a few seats independently.
state_notes.S25: West Bengal 2026: TMC leads INDIA alliance in state. BJP is primary NDA force. Left parties weakened but informally with INDIA. INC has minimal footprint.
state_notes.S26: Puducherry 2026: AINRC-BJP NDA alliance vs INC-DMK INDIA alliance. Territory has only 30 ACs; smaller parties and independents have historically won several seats.
